legend: The Marfa Lights (Texas, USA, first reported 1883)
lines: Texas, 1883. A young cowboy drives his cattle across a dark, empty plain.
Near Marfa, he sees a strange light flicker in the distance.
He thinks it is a campfire, so he heads toward it.
But when he arrives, there is nothing. No ashes, no footprints.
The lights keep coming back, night after night.
They float, split in two, and drift across the desert.
Some say they are ghosts, others say they are car lights far away.
Scientists have argued about it for over a hundred years.
Nobody has ever fully explained them.
What do you think they are?
title: Mysterious Lights Haunt the Texas Desert. Nobody Can Explain Them #shorts
description:
Since 1883, strange glowing lights have floated over the desert near Marfa, Texas. Ghosts, car headlights or something else? An old American mystery.
